references.text: The introduction to the law of jealousy, which describes the situation where a woman goes astray from her husband and becomes unclean, or where jealous suspicion arises.
The continuation of the law of jealousy, elaborating on when this law applies - when a spirit of jealousy comes over a man.
Prohibition against lying with another man's wife and becoming unclean with her - using the same terminology for uncleanness in cases of adultery.
The law concerning punishment for adultery - the death penalty for both the man and the woman who commit adultery.
A parallel law in Deuteronomy regarding the punishment for a man who lies with a married woman.
The wisdom of Proverbs on jealousy - describing how jealousy stirs up a man's anger, and he will not spare on the day of vengeance.
Ezekiel uses the image of an unfaithful wife as punishment for adultery and bloodshed - judgment against the adultery.
The prophet Hosea speaks about daughters and daughters-in-law who practice prostitution and commit adultery, with a thematic connection to infidelity.
